subject: Tata Sierra vs Hyundai Creta
_angle: OPT3 · Same money, different vibe — bold-rival hook, feature-for-feature, punchy cliffhanger; calm delivery (revised per brain critique)

segments.text: India's favourite SUV finally has a real rival — and both cost near eleven lakh. Sierra, or Creta?
The Sierra flexes: a hundred-sixty turbo, a panoramic roof, thirteen-speaker JBL.
The Creta counters: ventilated seats, wireless charging, and a bulletproof reputation.
One's the safe bet, the other turns heads — but which is smarter? Smash like for your pick.
